toolDefinitions.name: list_pricing_data
toolDefinitions.description: Discover local product IDs/names and available channel rule IDs with provenance. Choose only a matching record; clarify ambiguity.

toolDefinitions.name: get_product
toolDefinitions.description: Read product costs (BRL, grams, hours, kW) and provenance. Null is unknown.

toolDefinitions.name: get_channel_rule
toolDefinitions.description: Read separate revenue charge rates, fixed fee, source and validity. No Shopee rules exist.

toolDefinitions.name: calculate_scenarios
toolDefinitions.description: Deterministic C# costs and prices. Margins and discount are fractions. Uses stored product/rule, never model-invented costs. Includes undiscounted and discounted scenarios.

toolDefinitions.name: submit_recommendation
toolDefinitions.description: Submit a draft referring only to successful scenario IDs. No prices are applied. Human approval is required.

toolDefinitions.name: request_clarification
toolDefinitions.description: Stop and ask specific questions when essential data/rules/objectives are missing.

data.summary: Draft pricing comparison for headset-stand using synthetic demonstration product and synthetic direct channel rule as of 2026-10-24. Compared target revenue margins of 20%, 30%, and 40% with a 10% discount applied to each target. Discounted prices do not retain the requested revenue margins; the achieved margins fall below target in all three cases.
assumptions: Synthetic product costs are confirmed by the demonstration fixture only; not business-verified.
Synthetic channel rule applies a 10% revenue-based fee, BRL 2 fixed fee, and zero tax/advertising charges on the same revenue basis.
Failure provision is modelled using the stored 10% failure rate with full-print retry assumption.
All prices and margins are drafts and require human approval; no marketplace publication occurs.
Margin means revenue margin, not markup on production cost.
limitations: Unmodeled overhead is excluded beyond stored cost inputs and the channel rule.
Full-print retry assumption may overstate or understate real failure recovery costs.
No marketplace verification or live Shopee fee data is available; this is a synthetic demonstration rule only.
Discounted scenarios reduce revenue margin materially versus the requested target in every case.
